# Farrow 0.9.0

Farrow 0.9.0 makes every failure say what went wrong and what to do next, lets
interrupted operations recover without detours, and previews `farrow mac`:
macOS virtual machines on Apple Silicon.

Farrow remains pre-1.0, so this release uses GitHub's pre-release channel.
Select `FARROW_VERSION=0.9.0` when running the release installer. 中文说明见下文。

## Changes

- **One failure shape.** Every failure prints `error:`, the last stderr lines
  of the external program that failed, and `next:` when one action fits.
  JSON failures carry a class from a closed set, a stable `reason`, `next`, and
  the failing `command`. Exit codes keep their numbers with sharper meanings.
- **Recovery without detours.** A node whose QEMU PID was reused after a host
  reboot is recognized as stopped. Interrupted transitions name the command
  that finishes them, `destroy` settles them itself, and a failed first `up`
  recovers once the inventory is fixed. A second command waits up to ten
  minutes behind a running one and names it; `status`, `ssh`, `exec`,
  `ssh-config`, and `hosts` do not wait.
- **Plans before privileges.** `setup` says when it will use sudo and where
  socket_vmnet comes from. `network` and `hosts` install/uninstall confirm on a
  terminal. `plan` lists each node's data disks, including the implicit
  128 GiB `/data`.
- **Errors that point at the fix.** Inventory errors state the rule, value, and
  line and suggest the nearest `vm_*` key. `ssh` and `exec` refuse a near-miss
  node name instead of running it on the default node. A symlinked
  `~/.ssh/config` is never edited.
- **macOS guests (preview).** `farrow mac` creates named macOS 27 virtual
  machines on an Apple Silicon Mac with macOS 27: copy-on-write clones of one
  base installed from Apple's restore image, which is downloaded only from
  Apple after asking and verified. Each machine has its own private network
  and fixed address, pinned SSH keys, shared folders, and a native desktop
  with text clipboard sharing. It never needs root and never reads
  `farrow.yml`.

## macOS guests are a preview

This release's archives and packages do not include the native Mac component,
`Farrow Mac.app`: it must be Developer ID signed and notarized by Apple first,
and a later release will include it. Until then `farrow mac` explains that the
component is missing. To try it, build both from the tag with Xcode 27 on an
Apple Silicon Mac running macOS 27:

```bash
git clone --branch v0.9.0 https://github.com/pgsty/farrow
cd farrow
make mac-build
export PATH="$PWD/bin/mac:$PATH"
farrow mac doctor
```

The first `farrow mac up` asks before downloading about 25 GiB from Apple. See
the [macOS guide](https://farrow.pgsty.com/docs/start/macos/).

## Upgrade notes

- **Scripts that read exit codes or JSON errors need a check.** `integrity` (7)
  now means only a failed digest, identity, or ownership check; unclassified
  failures are `runtime` (1). `recreate_required` and `nodes_removed` moved
  from `error` to `reason` (class `conflict`), and `resource_conflict` is now
  `resource`. The [changelog](https://github.com/pgsty/farrow/blob/v0.9.0/CHANGELOG.md)
  lists every moved case.
- `farrow rm` is gone; type `farrow purge` in full to discard a lab.
- Deployment state is unchanged. 0.9.0 manages labs created by 0.8.0 without
  recreating nodes, and 0.8.0 can manage them again after a downgrade.

## Validation

The release runtime is `07ebfd4`; the commits after it change only
documentation. It passed complete local `make check`, the native component
tests, and the Mac bundle build.

On an Apple Silicon Mac with macOS 27.0 and QEMU 11.1.1 (HVF), a two-node lab
(Debian 13.7 and Ubuntu 24.04.5) created by 0.8.0 was upgraded in place:
`plan` reported no changes, `up` kept both QEMU processes, `exec` kept argument
boundaries and passed exit status 37 through, unknown node names failed as
usage errors that list the nodes, a guest file survived stop and start, and
`doctor` was healthy. 0.8.0 then managed the same lab again before 0.9.0
destroyed it.

On the same Mac, `farrow mac` passed all 16 automated live phases in
298.9 s with an ad-hoc signed build of the component from the same
commit: creation from a prepared base, shared folders, isolated per-machine
networks, SSH exit codes and argument boundaries, stop and start, `configure`,
the two-VM limit, `recreate`, the desktop with two-way clipboard, and
`destroy`. A first attempt had failed one listing check taken seconds after a
new machine's first boot; the machine answered normally, and the rerun passed.
Two independent reviews of the Mac code and packaging came first; their fixes
are listed in the
[acceptance log](https://github.com/pgsty/farrow/blob/v0.9.0/docs/mac-implementation-log.md).

Not covered by this release's runs: native Linux (KVM) hosts and the
seven-system matrix, where the four-host 0.8.0 run remains the latest
evidence; macOS amd64 and Linux arm64; a physical-host reboot; and a complete
Pigsty installation. For `farrow mac`: downloading and installing macOS
through the current CLI, Developer ID signing and notarization, the desktop's
**Restart…** and **Shut Down…** menu items, and a logout or restart of the Mac
with a machine running.

From a clean checkout at the release tag, with the pinned toolchain available:

```bash
make check
make release-local VERSION=0.9.0
```

The local release target verifies archives, Linux packages, checksums, and
SBOMs without publishing. The tag workflow independently builds and verifies
the assets attached to this release.

# Farrow 0.9.0（中文）

Farrow 0.9.0 让每个失败都说明出了什么问题、下一步做什么；中断的操作无需绕路即可
恢复；并预览 `farrow mac`：在 Apple 芯片 Mac 上运行 macOS 虚拟机。
Farrow 仍处于 1.0 之前，本版沿用 GitHub pre-release 通道；运行发布安装器时显式指定
`FARROW_VERSION=0.9.0`。

## 主要变化

- **统一的失败格式。** 每个失败都输出 `error:`、失败的外部程序最后几行 stderr，以及
  在有明确下一步时输出 `next:`。JSON 失败带有封闭集合中的类别、稳定的 `reason`、
  `next` 与失败的 `command`。退出码数值不变，含义更精确。
- **恢复无需绕路。** 宿主重启后 QEMU PID 被复用的节点会被识别为已停止。中断的状态转换
  会写明用哪个命令收尾，`destroy` 会自行收尾；首次 `up` 失败后，修正配置即可恢复。
  第二个命令会在正在运行的命令之后最多等待十分钟，并说明是哪个命令；`status`、`ssh`、
  `exec`、`ssh-config` 与 `hosts` 不等待。
- **先说明，再提权。** `setup` 说明何时使用 sudo 以及 socket_vmnet 的来源；
  `network` 与 `hosts` 的安装和卸载在终端中先确认；`plan` 列出每个节点的数据盘，
  包括默认的 128 GiB `/data`。
- **错误指向修复方法。** 配置错误给出规则、取值与行号，并提示最接近的 `vm_*` 键；
  `ssh` 与 `exec` 拒绝与节点名只差一点的参数，而不是把它当作命令在默认节点上执行；
  符号链接形式的 `~/.ssh/config` 不会被修改。
- **macOS 客机（预览）。** `farrow mac` 在运行 macOS 27 的 Apple 芯片 Mac 上创建命名的
  macOS 27 虚拟机：它们是同一个基础镜像的写时复制克隆，基础镜像由 Apple 恢复镜像安装，
  该镜像只从 Apple 下载、下载前先询问并校验。每台机器有独立私网与固定地址、固定的
  SSH 密钥、共享目录，以及支持文本剪贴板共享的原生桌面。它从不需要 root，也从不读取
  `farrow.yml`。

## macOS 客机为预览

本版的归档与软件包不包含原生 Mac 组件 `Farrow Mac.app`：它必须先经过 Developer ID
签名与 Apple 公证，将在后续版本中提供。在此之前，`farrow mac` 会说明组件缺失。
如需试用，请在运行 macOS 27 的 Apple 芯片 Mac 上用 Xcode 27 从该 tag 构建：

```bash
git clone --branch v0.9.0 https://github.com/pgsty/farrow
cd farrow
make mac-build
export PATH="$PWD/bin/mac:$PATH"
farrow mac doctor
```

首次执行 `farrow mac up` 时，会先询问再从 Apple 下载约 25 GiB。详见
[macOS 教程](https://farrow.pgsty.com/zh/docs/start/macos/)。

## 升级说明

- **读取退出码或 JSON 错误的脚本需要检查。** `integrity`（7）现在只表示摘要、身份或
  属主校验失败；未分类的失败为 `runtime`（1）。`recreate_required` 与 `nodes_removed`
  从 `error` 移到 `reason`（类别 `conflict`），`resource_conflict` 改为 `resource`。
  所有变动见 [CHANGELOG](https://github.com/pgsty/farrow/blob/v0.9.0/CHANGELOG.md)。
- 删除 `farrow rm`；丢弃实验环境需要完整输入 `farrow purge`。
- 部署状态格式不变：0.9.0 可以管理 0.8.0 创建的实验环境且不重建节点，降级后 0.8.0
  仍可继续管理。

## 验收范围

发布运行时为 `07ebfd4`，其后的提交只修改文档。它通过完整本地 `make check`、原生组件
测试与 Mac 发布包构建。

在运行 macOS 27.0、QEMU 11.1.1（HVF）的 Apple 芯片 Mac 上，由 0.8.0 创建的两节点实验
环境（Debian 13.7 与 Ubuntu 24.04.5）完成原位升级：`plan` 显示无变化，`up` 保持两个
QEMU 进程不变，`exec` 保留参数边界并透传退出码 37，未知节点名按 usage 错误拒绝并列出
节点，停启后客机文件保留，`doctor` 健康。随后 0.8.0 再次管理同一实验环境，最后由 0.9.0
销毁。

在同一台 Mac 上，使用同一提交构建、ad-hoc 签名的组件，`farrow mac` 用 298.9 秒
通过全部 16 个自动化实机阶段：从已准备的基础镜像创建、共享目录、彼此隔离的每机网络、SSH
退出码与参数边界、停启、`configure`、两台上限、`recreate`、桌面与双向剪贴板，以及
`destroy`。首次尝试在新机器首次启动后数秒的一次列表检查中失败，该机器随后正常响应，
重跑全部通过。此前两位审查者独立审阅了 Mac 代码与打包，修复记录见
[验收日志](https://github.com/pgsty/farrow/blob/v0.9.0/docs/mac-implementation-log.md)。

本版验收未覆盖：Linux（KVM）原生宿主与七系统矩阵（最近证据仍是 0.8.0 的四主机验收）、
macOS amd64 与 Linux arm64、物理宿主重启，以及完整 Pigsty 安装。`farrow mac` 方面：
用当前 CLI 下载并安装 macOS、Developer ID 签名与公证、桌面菜单中的 **Restart…** 与
**Shut Down…**，以及有机器运行时注销或重启 Mac。

`make release-local VERSION=0.9.0` 只在本地构建与校验归档、Linux 包、校验清单和 SBOM；
tag 工作流独立构建并验证本次发布资产。
